title: No real entry point calls assertCaptureHostIdSetting at start; the scheduler swallows the lazy refusal (B3-C6 call sites outside the unit)
evidence: Proposals A-P1 and B-P1. scripts/webinar/scheduler/deps-runtime.mjs:64-65 and :77-79 (catch gives an empty capability set, so a bad setting surfaces only as 'Each capture slot requires reviewed real host capability evidence'); scripts/native-capture/server.ts:39 (per receipt only); capture-slot-acceptance.ts:109, :124 (fails closed); tab-session-workspace.ts:95 (after consent and session claim); API host; manifest CORE-REQUEST lines 98-101. B3-C5 'process exits non-zero at start' is measured at the validator and in a real child process, not at any real entry point: NOT-MEASURED. Fails closed, so no unsafe path; the cause is hidden.
fix_direction: The owning units (B4, P1 or B9) call the validator once at boot in deps-runtime.mjs, server.ts and the API host before first use. Must land before B5 sets a value.
